[SWS_DM_02051] Reporting successful reset of ECU to IdsM
⌈
In case a diagnostic service ECUReset is received, which results in a positive re-
sponse, The DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_ECU_RESET_SUCCESSFUL
to IdsM (see [13] and table [SWS_DM_02052]) with the context data given in
[SWS_DM_02052].
Hint: the report of the security event is done after RequestReset() and before calling
ExecuteReset()
⌋
